baseline_models.mechanism: The focus-root branches compose an explicit act of beautifying the nearer heaven by means of lamp-like celestial lights.

activation_trace.role: marks deliberate beautification or the showing of beauty
supplies the over-arching heaven as the adorned domain
specifies the nearer or lower heaven
identifies the adornment as lamps or celestial luminaries

changed_reading.before: The clause merely reports lights in the sky.
changed_reading.after: The clause presents the lamp-like lights as the means of a deliberate beautification of the nearer heaven.

baseline_models.mechanism: The predicative making construction assigns the already-mentioned lights a second role directed against rebellious devils; the stone image in رُجُومًا supplies the concrete projectile profile.

activation_trace.role: assigns the antecedent a resulting state or function
contributes the concrete image of stones underlying the projectiles
identifies the targets as defiant, rebellious devils

changed_reading.before: The lights and the missiles are two loosely adjacent descriptions.
changed_reading.after: The same antecedent is deliberately assigned both an ornamental role and a projectile role against rebellious devils.

baseline_models.mechanism: Preparation, punitive pain, and kindled fire combine into a reserved punishment rather than a generic bad outcome.

activation_trace.role: presents the punishment as present, ready, and prepared
specifies painful punishment
specifies blazing, kindled fire

changed_reading.before: The verse closes with a conventional threat.
changed_reading.after: The verse closes with a punishment already made ready and characterized by actively kindled fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same heaven is introduced immediately before the focus and subjected to repeated acts of seeing and directed visual inspection. The lamps in 67:5 therefore answer the preceding gaze sequence with a positive visible feature.

activation_trace.role: establishes the layered heavens as the domain under inspection
repeats the command's visual test of creation
names eyesight as the instrument of the test
extends the repeated gaze directly up to the focus verse

structural_cues: The repeated seeing and eyesight vocabulary culminates before the explicit beautification clause.
The heaven named at 67:3 is resumed as the nearer heaven at 67:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The adornment is not decorative information in isolation; it is the salient visible confirmation encountered after the reader is told to inspect the heavens repeatedly.

changed_reading.before: The lamps are a self-contained image of celestial beauty.
changed_reading.after: The lamps are the visible culmination of the preceding inspection of the ordered heavens.

minimal_triggers: 67:3 ر ء ي at words 7 and 16
67:4 ب ص ر at words 3 and 7
context_deltas.ablation: Without 67:3-4, the lexical adornment reading survives, but its role as the answer to a repeated visual test disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context repeats making as functional disposition, then couples the heaven with a threat of a pelting wind. Together these cues strengthen the focus clause's assignment of a projectile function within a controlled upper domain.

activation_trace.role: parallels making the earth into an assigned usable condition
returns to heaven as the locus from which a threat can issue
repeats the upper-domain frame for the pelting threat
supplies the later image of a stone-bearing or pelting wind sent from above

structural_cues: 67:15 uses جَعَلَ with an object and an assigned condition, matching the focus verse's predicative construction.
67:16-17 repeat the heaven phrase in paired threats.
The حَاصِبًا threat in 67:17 provides a later pelting image without identifying it with the lamps.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The second half of 67:5 is best heard as a purposeful assignment of force to the lights, participating in the surah's broader portrayal of controlled action from the upper realm.

changed_reading.before: The missile clause is an isolated second fact about the lights.
changed_reading.after: The missile clause is a functional assignment that anticipates the later heaven-and-pelting threat pattern.

minimal_triggers: 67:17 س م و at word 5 plus ح ص ب at word 9
context_deltas.ablation: Removing 67:15 weakens the constructional parallel; removing 67:16-17 leaves the projectile sense intact but removes its later upper-domain echo.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate lexical recurrence and narrative expansion turn the focus verse's prepared blaze into a hinge: punishment is repeated in 67:6, enacted through casting and boiling in 67:7, and named again as the Blaze in 67:10-11.

activation_trace.role: immediately repeats the punishment term at the opening of the next verse
enacts punishment as people are cast into it
turns the fire image into boiling and surging motion
repeats the Blaze as the destination acknowledged by its companions
closes the punishment scene by repeating the Blaze designation

structural_cues: 67:5 ends with عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ and 67:6 immediately begins another عَذَابُ construction.
67:7 supplies motion and sound to the punishment announced at 67:5-6.
67:10-11 repeat ٱلسَّعِيرِ at the close of the scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The final clause of 67:5 is the threshold of the following punishment tableau, not an appended threat; the ready fire becomes a narrated, boiling destination.

changed_reading.before: Prepared blazing punishment is asserted but remains abstract.
changed_reading.after: The assertion opens directly into a sustained scene of punishment, casting, boiling, and repeated naming of the Blaze.

minimal_triggers: 67:7 ل ق ي at word 2 plus ف و ر at word 8
context_deltas.ablation: Without 67:6-11, the focus still denotes prepared fiery punishment, but its hinge function and sensory realization are lost.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treat this as a secondary root-level resonance only. The form مَصَٰبِيحَ remains the lamp branch B005; the beauty branch B006 must not replace its lexical sense.

activation_trace.role: foregrounds beautification
adds a contained resonance of radiance, beauty, and brightness beneath the lamp noun

changed_reading.before: The lamps beautify only because they are placed ornaments.
changed_reading.after: Their lamp sense remains primary, while the root's radiance-and-beauty branch faintly reinforces the explicit act of beautification.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Keep physical projectiles primary because رُجُومًا is predicated of the lamps. The expulsion branch may describe the effect on the devils, but it cannot turn the phrase into mere verbal cursing.

activation_trace.role: adds expulsion and banishment as a possible effect of the pelting
makes rebellious devils the fitting objects of exclusion

changed_reading.before: The projectiles only strike hostile targets.
changed_reading.after: The physical pelting may also carry a contained banishing effect against the rebellious targets.

discarded_or_unchanged: The later ص ب ح occurrence at 67:30 belongs to the become branch B010, so it does not shift مَصَٰبِيحَ away from the lamp branch B005.
The context strengthens the projectile function but does not resolve whether the antecedent denotes the lamps wholesale or projectiles associated with them.
The punishment sequence strengthens the final clause without proving that every punished group in 67:6-11 has the same immediate referent as لَهُمْ in 67:5.

strongest_changes: The adornment becomes the visible culmination of the repeated inspection in 67:3-4.
The missile clause becomes a purposeful functional assignment echoed by the later heaven-and-pelting threat in 67:15-17.
The prepared Blaze becomes the hinge into the sustained punishment scene of 67:6-11.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse compresses beauty, controlled force, and prepared punishment into one sequence. Its context first makes the lamps answer a visual test, then unfolds the final fire phrase into the next scene, while later verses echo both functional making and force from heaven.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the exact antecedent scope of the feminine singular pronoun in وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا.
The root branches do not determine whether رُجُومًا denotes the luminous bodies themselves or projectiles proceeding from or associated with them.
The local context supports a transition between the punishment of devils and the punishment of disbelievers but does not erase their distinct referents.
